notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 8': Watch Your Step, Tatooine, Cantina, Tatooine Docking Bay 94, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Squadron Assignments, Insurrection and 'First Strike'; they count toward the 60.

Posted 'First Strike' dested Draw Their Fire: First Strike is the Dark Side card; Draw Their Fire is its Light counterpart with the same game text, and the strategy says 'You start with Draw their Fire'.
Posted 'Gen.DB' dested the generic Spaceport Docking Bay; 'Home1DB' dested Home One: Docking Bay; 'Tat. DB' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Tattoine' dested the Light Premiere Tatooine system.
Posted 'Wedge' dested Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader because the strategy pilots 'Wedge in Red 1' (Red Squadron 1, whose text keys on the Death Star II Wedge).
Posted 'T. Nett' dested Theron Nett (Red 10 is his X-wing); 'Gold Squad 1 (Imm to Roll)' dested Gold Squadron 1 (immune to Tallon Roll); 'Dash' dested Dash Rendar.
Posted 'Celeberation or Bacta Tank' is one line naming two cards; kept as written (UNKNOWN). Celeberation is likely Tatooine Celebration.
Posted 'I`ve got a bad...  (triple card)' kept as written (UNKNOWN); the post says it triples battle damage and is not I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This by game text, so no card is picked.
Section headers 'Green Cards 2' and 'Adm. Order 1' were parsed as cards in the draft and removed.

The signature reads 'Martin Falke, 2nd at Ralltiir National'; the post does not say this list was played there. He says he and Bastian Winkelhaus (who played a very similar version) played each other three times at their Nationals.
